description: Source code for x86 instruction analysis functions in a disassembler library, including validation, address retrieval, operand analysis, and instruction tagging.

methods.name: x86_insn_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if an instruction is valid based on its type and size.

methods.name: x86_get_address
methods.description: Retrieves the address from an instruction's operands, handling offset and absolute types.

methods.name: x86_get_rel_offset
methods.description: Gets the relative offset from instruction operands.

methods.name: x86_get_branch_target
methods.description: Returns the branch target operand if present.

methods.name: x86_get_imm
methods.description: Returns the immediate operand if present.

methods.name: x86_get_raw_imm
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw immediate data in the instruction bytes.

methods.name: x86_operand_size
methods.description: Determines the size in bytes of an operand based on its datatype.

methods.name: x86_set_insn_addr
methods.description: Sets the address of an instruction.

methods.name: x86_set_insn_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset of an instruction.

methods.name: x86_set_insn_function
methods.description: Associates a function pointer with an instruction.

methods.name: x86_set_insn_block
methods.description: Associates a block pointer with an instruction.

methods.name: x86_untag_insn
methods.description: Removes the tag from an instruction.

methods.name: x86_insn_is_tagged
methods.description: Checks if an instruction is tagged.
